about.hero_title: Private AI that keeps your documents under your control.
about.hero_subtitle: We built Allybi for people who work with sensitive files and can't afford chaos — or surveillance. Store, search, and ask questions across your documents with privacy-first design.
about.trust_line: Privacy-first by design. Built for high-stakes work.
about.trust_title: Privacy isn't a feature. It's the foundation.
about.trust_body: Allybi is designed so your information stays yours. We prioritize control, clarity, and security — even when it's inconvenient.
about.trust_bullet_5: Clear, verifiable outputs (grounded in your files)
about.capabilities_subtitle: Allybi doesn't just find your files — it helps you work with them. Two new capabilities, still private, still under your control.
about.cap_edit_desc: Edit documents and spreadsheets directly through Allybi using natural language. No need to open another app.
about.cap_edit_b1: Rewrite paragraphs and sections in .docx files
about.cap_edit_b2: Update table data with simple instructions
about.cap_edit_b3: Create spreadsheet formulas and calculations in .xlsx
about.cap_edit_b4: Export changes back to your original file format
about.cap_connect_desc: Search across your messages and emails with natural language. Draft replies and attach the right document — without remembering the file name.
about.cap_connect_b1: Search emails and messages using plain language
about.cap_connect_b2: Draft and send with explicit confirmation before delivery
about.cap_connect_b3: Attach files from Allybi (e.g. "attach the latest cap table")
about.cap_connect_b4: Permissioned access — you choose what's connected
about.building_intro: Allybi exists to make working with documents feel calm again — no chaos, no surveillance, no complexity. Just clarity and control.
about.card_mission_body: Give professionals, families, and teams a privacy-first AI that turns messy folders into instant, trustworthy answers — so they can spend their time thinking, not searching.
about.card_vision_body: A world where everyone has calm, private control over their information: one place to ask anything they've worked on and get the right answer in seconds.
about.card_values_body: Privacy first. Clarity over complexity. Respect your time. We build tools that are fast, honest, and never trade your data for convenience.
about.why_body: Most tools force a tradeoff: convenience or privacy. Allybi is built to give you both — without drowning you in complexity.
about.why_card1_desc: Your documents stay under your control.
about.why_card2_desc: Designed to feel obvious — not overwhelming.
about.why_card3_desc: Store, search, and organize without scattered tools.
about.final_cta_support: Start in minutes. Keep your documents private, organized, and useful.
